title: Regularity ascends along smooth ring maps
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings which is a smooth ring map [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], and assume $R$ is a regular ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] (Noetherian, with every localization at a prime ideal a regular local ring). Then $S$ is a regular ring.
